problem.title: Minimum Moves to Equal Array Elements II

approaches.title: Choose a median and sum distances
approaches.summary: Use a median as the target value, which minimizes the total absolute difference, then sum each element’s distance from it.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Sort the array, take its middle element as the median, and sum absolute differences.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 462: use quickselect instead of sorting
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Use `select_nth_unstable` to find the median without fully sorting, then sum absolute differences.
